calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h2drv/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h2drv/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h2drv --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

notes: UNQUALIFIED DIAGNOSTIC: independent ideal clock sources use fixed nominal CTS TT -R at150ps slew for all early/late/corners; physical die driver/slot binding and raw multi-root export are required. Do not publish compensated near-zeroR views. H2 diagnostic reuses H1 nominal clock reference only provisionally to collect new raw R; requires fresh bound H2 nominal reference and full numerical/clock/per-bit reach evidence before any route.
structural_change: H1 FAST4 actual CTS6 setup+66.55 hold+7.73 but raw load0 output launch f357.9/o256 exceeds220. Default-off FORWARD_HOP2 moves rb1 to request root and selects separate N-input/S-output flop stages, with existing two-cycle return model; bank ED3 and BE MD12 retained. New raw R required; output surplus buffers require hold-safe repair. Wider slot remains unallocated. H2 driver candidate disables redundant generic port buffering after explicit recipe2 pin BUF/HB4/BUF stages, and uses actual BUFx12f lead/final drivers instead of4f (input stages also use12f). HB4 delays remain, all setup/hold checked; no IO/clock/skew relaxation. This experiment requires actual gate and raw output profile before acceptance.
